Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Fontana for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from December 3 (the Tree Lighting Ceremony) through December 15 (the Library Winter Luau at Fontana Lewis Library), with Pictures with Santa (December 4 and 5), the Fontana Christmas Parade (December 12) and the Festival of Winter (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Fontana

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Fontana
  • 3 free events, including the Tree Lighting Ceremony, Pictures with Santa and the Fontana Christmas Parade
  • Meet Santa: free Pictures with Santa at the Jessie Turner Center, Heritage Center and Don Day Center (December 4 and 5) and a free picture with Santa at the Library Winter Luau (December 15)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Tree Lighting Ceremony (December 3) and the Fontana Christmas Parade on Sierra Avenue (December 12)
  • Festival and library fun: the Festival of Winter (December 12) and the Library Winter Luau at Fontana Lewis Library (December 15)
  • Season: December 3 to December 15

Planning a bigger day out? Fontana families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Rancho Cucamonga, which covers Victoria Gardens, Santa visits and holiday lights nearby.
